_comment: Cancel reasons for closing a coaching as CANCELLED from Argos. 'value' is the closedReason enum sent to GCA; 'label' is what the coach sees. Enum pattern (confirmed from HAR for the first one): UPPERCASE the label, spaces/hyphens/slashes -> underscore, drop other punctuation. e.g. 'Associate declined coaching' -> ASSOCIATE_DECLINED_COACHING. The other 7 are derived from that pattern; if a real cancel ever fails for one, fix its 'value' here (no rebuild needed — read at runtime).

reasons.label: Associate not available - Not in the same process
Associate not available - Not on site
Associate not at fault - Process issue
Associate not at fault - Defects detected while performing support role
Associate not at fault - Machine/tool issue
Associate not at fault - ASIN issue
